seo.metaTitle: White-Label Online Fax for Partners | Hostopia
seo.metaDescription: Offer secure cloud fax under your brand. Hostopia's white-label Online Fax replaces legacy machines with HIPAA-aligned, email-integrated digital faxing.

hero.headline: Replace Legacy Fax Machines — Keep Trusted Workflows
hero.description: Many SMBs still rely on fax for contracts, medical records, and legal documents, yet legacy fax machines are costly, insecure, and tied to physical offices. Hostopia's white-label Online Fax delivers a secure, cloud-based service that modernizes how your customers send and receive documents — without disrupting the workflows they depend on every day.

sidebar.heading: Help Your Customers Modernize Fax—Without Disrupting Their Workflow

items.title: Work From Anywhere
items.body:
• Enable your customers to send and receive faxes from any device — laptop, mobile, tablet, or desktop
• Support remote teams, field staff, and multi-location businesses with no hardware required
• Eliminate phone lines and physical machines while keeping familiar workflows intact

image.alt: Working remotely with mobile and cloud tools

items.title: Built for Compliance
items.body:
• Encrypt every fax transmission to protect sensitive information
• Support HIPAA-aligned configurations for regulated industries like healthcare and legal
• Help customers modernize fax without introducing compliance risk

items.title: Keep Existing Numbers
items.body:
• Allow customers to port existing fax numbers without disruption
• Offer new local and toll-free numbers for added flexibility
• Remove barriers to switching by keeping customer-facing information unchanged

image.alt: Business phone and fax number management

items.title: Seamless Workflow Integration
items.body:
• Let customers send faxes directly from email and receive them as PDFs in their inbox
• Provide a simple browser-based portal for full visibility and control
• Avoid new software installs or retraining with a familiar, intuitive experience

items.title: Flexible Plans That Scale
items.body:
• Support usage from low-volume individuals to high-volume teams
• Enable shared page pools, admin controls, and per-number tracking
• Give customers a scalable solution that grows with their business

features.heading: Modern Fax Infrastructure — Without the Infrastructure
features.intro: Online Fax replaces physical machines with a secure, digital experience that works the way SMBs already work — through email and browser — and plugs naturally into your communications portfolio.

cards.title: Email & Web-Based Faxing
cards.body: Send faxes directly from email or a web portal. Support for PDF, DOC, PPT, and image formats. No additional software or drivers required.

cards.title: Security & Compliance
cards.body: Encrypted transmission with HIPAA-aligned configurations. Built for industries that handle sensitive documents — healthcare, legal, financial, insurance.

cards.title: Multi-User Plans
cards.body: Shared page pools for teams, admin roles, usage reporting, and per-number tracking. Scale from solo practitioners to multi-location businesses.

cards.title: Productivity Tools
cards.body: Cover pages, group sends, delivery confirmations, and centralized fax logs. Everything SMBs need to manage document workflows efficiently.

cards.title: Number Porting & New Numbers
cards.body: Port existing fax numbers without disruption, or provision new local and toll-free numbers on demand — customers never lose continuity.

cards.title: White-Label Platform & Support
cards.body: Branded portal, branded support, branded billing — Hostopia handles the platform while you own every customer touchpoint.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Monetize a Critical Communication Channel
partnerAdvantage.intro: Online Fax modernizes a service SMBs can't give up — and turns it into a recurring cloud subscription on your platform instead of a legacy landline billed by someone else.

items.title: Create stickier bundles
items.body: Pair Online Fax with connectivity, VoIP, and business email. The more communication services on your platform, the harder it is for customers to leave — and the easier it is to defend against commodity competitors.

items.title: Convert analog users to cloud subscriptions
items.body: Migrate customers off legacy fax lines and hardware while keeping them on your network. Every converted line is new recurring cloud revenue replacing aging TDM infrastructure.

items.title: Low support, high attach
items.body: Browser- and email-based experience means minimal support burden. Hostopia maintains the platform, handles compliance, and operates the fax network — you sell the service and collect the revenue.

items.title: Win regulated verticals
items.body: HIPAA-aligned configurations unlock healthcare, legal, and financial industries — high-value verticals that pay premium rates for trusted, compliant communication services.
